تكتشفوا (form VIII)
# تَكْتَشِفُوا (taktašifū) /tak.ta.ʃi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# تُكْتَشَفُوا (tuktašafū) /tuk.ta.ʃa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
